pages.title: 01 // THE INVISIBLE DISASTER
pages.content:
A web crash gives you an error log. An automated video pipeline crash gives you 1,000 ruined renders.

Without schema guardrails, silent drift causes text overflow, missing hex colors, or 404 image URLs after hours of render time and spent cloud budget.

pages.title: 02 // THE THREE WINDOW PIPELINE
pages.content:
Window 1 (Architect): Extracts JSON specs and defines Zod schemas.
Window 2 (Builder): Receives schemas and writes Remotion React code.
Window 3 (Engine): Executes headless rendering.
Role collisions are forbidden.

pages.title: 03 // THE DOORSTEP RULE & SWISS GUARDRAILS
pages.content: Validate incoming data at the doorstep with Zod. If props fail validation, kill the job in 2 milliseconds ($0.00 cost) before spending compute.
